# Historical baseline

`baseline_fc702b1_gh_stack_view.py` is the verbatim
`packages/sc-gh-stack/scripts/gh_stack_view.py` from synaptic-canvas commit
`fc702b179f16911bad719dd0253d75c34ad16355`.

SHA-256: `b7cb5dd349d427e86fc50ea714da0df241dae7c37af804e89bbd1796907f7870`.

This frozen comparison input is not production code and must not be corrected
alongside the current implementation. The benchmark supplies fake GitHub
transport and local temporary repositories. Keeping the fixture here permits
the same 120-layer comparison in shallow clones and source archives without
fetching history or invoking GitHub.
